snippet.title: Map-Center's Palace Jam 1 Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer by Ziutek: https://www.twitch.tv/ketuiz
Voiceover by Chnucki Erdbeer

Last year American game designer, video game artist, and illustrator of tabletop role-playing games Jennell Jaquays passed away. Back when Map-Center was still a forum website in the early 2000’s she was a regular, helping people like me out, who were trying to get into Quake 3 mapping. As a tribute to her, we organized the Quake 2 Remaster Palace Jam. A fitting homage to her work on Quake 2’s E3U1 and I have to say, our Map-Center community delivered in spades!

The Palace Jam 1 Mission Pack contains 6 brand new maps, including a hub and a final boss fight. Time to gear up marine, we’ve got a city to burn! Ooh-rah!

You can download Map-Center’s Palace Jam 1 here: 

https://www.moddb.com/games/quake-ii-rerelease/addons/quake-2-re-release-palace-jam-1

Don't forget to visit our Discord server: https://discord.gg/vSvqwys5hB
